steps.title: Populate infos-pratiques via Jahia MCP (idempotent, with images)
acceptance_criteria: IDEMPOTENT: for each path in orchestration/sitemaps/sial-paris-infos.txt, content.get (locale fr) to check; if missing page.create, else REUSE - never recreate. Then fill each empty page's main area with content components mirroring the reference URL on https://www.sialparis.com/fr-FR. Use lowercase node names. Publish each page (publication.publish).

IMAGES are already imported - read orchestration/images/sial-paris.imported.json (keyed by page path; each entry has jcrPath + role). Reference those jcrPath nodes as weakreferences: role 'hero' -> the page hero/banner image; 'person' -> personCard photo; 'section' -> imgContentBlock/editorial image. Every page MUST display its hero banner. Do NOT fetch images.

REUSE existing sialp: types (run inventory.sh first); add a view if markup differs but properties match; never invent a type. FAQ=faqSection/faqItem, pricing=pricingTable/pricingTier, people=peopleGrid/personCard already exist.
Use the Jahia MCP server (JSON-RPC at $JAHIA_HOST/modules/mcp, Authorization APIToken from project .env) for ALL content ops. content.create/content.update/publication.publish.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/sial-paris sialp orchestration/component-baseline.txt
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/content.sh projects/sial-paris sial-paris fr @orchestration/sitemaps/sial-paris-infos.txt
